svg.title: gzip compression: zipir presets against every peer level
svg.desc: zipir fast, even, and dense against zlib-ng 1 to 9, igzip 0 to 3, and libdeflate 1 to 12.
svg.text: gzip compression: zipir presets against every peer level
zlib-ng 1 to 9, ISA-L igzip 0 to 3, and libdeflate's CLI 1 to 12 (dashed: it reads the whole file into memory, a quality reference). Up and to the right is better.
Ratio is plaintext bytes / compressed bytes. MB/s is plaintext MB (10^6 bytes) per second of median wall time. Each panel has its own scales.
Peers come from a run of every level; zipir from the report run. zlib-ng 0 (stored) is left out.
